# WebGazer 3.5.3

Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/webgazer/-/webgazer-3.5.3.tgz
Upstream: https://github.com/brownhci/WebGazer
License: GPL-3.0-or-later; see webgazer-LICENSE.md. The distribution header also
contains an additional permission; consult upstream before relying on it.

webgazer.js and mediapipe/face_mesh are unmodified files from the package's dist directory.
MediaPipe Face Mesh is distributed under Apache-2.0; see its package.json and file headers.
The application lazily loads these resources from this site, only after camera consent.
Camera images and calibration samples remain in the isolated browser frame and are not uploaded or persisted.

The upstream project no longer guarantees updates as of February 24, 2026.
